subject: Literature
title: Ocean Vuong's Poetry and Prose
description: One-minute skill: Ocean Vuong's Poetry and Prose.

hook.text: Ocean Vuong's mother could not read, so he wrote her a novel she would never be able to finish — and it became a bestseller.

buildup.text: On Earth We're Briefly Gorgeous is a letter from a Vietnamese American son to his illiterate mother about family and war.

discovery.text: Vuong began as a poet, and his prose carries poetry's intensity, making every sentence feel carved rather than written.

twist.text: He arrived in America at two, speaking no English, and learned the language that would make him one of its finest writers.

climax.text: Vuong proved that literature can bridge the unbridgeable: languages, generations, and the silence between parent and child.

punchline.text: He wrote a masterpiece his mother could never read.

quiz.question: What form does On Earth We're Briefly Gorgeous take?
options: A collection of separate short stories
A letter from a son to his illiterate mother
